cacheKey.factsHash: sha256(stableSerialize(canonicalFacts)) where canonicalFacts = { symbol, candle{openTime,closeTime}, factsVersion, facts }
cacheKey.canonicalization: recursive key sorting, -0 normalised to 0, undefined rejected, non-finite numbers rejected

cacheValue.note: the frozen record deliberately stores only the structured decision triple, never the model prose

MISSBehaviour.consequence: the service emits 4H_BIAS_DECISION_CACHE_MISS and calls the LLM exactly once

HITBehaviour.lookup: reads the file, then validateRecord() rebuilds the identity from the record and requires an exact match on decisionKey, factsHash and the full decisionKeyFields
HITBehaviour.consequence: emits 4H_BIAS_DECISION_CACHE_HIT with decisionSource FROZEN_STORE and makes ZERO LLM calls
HITBehaviour.factsUsed: the facts stored inside the record, not the freshly computed ones

corruptionPolicy.behaviour: any schema, hash or enum mismatch raises BIAS_DECISION_STORE_CORRUPT
corruptionPolicy.serviceReaction: the snapshot becomes UNAVAILABLE, no LLM call is made and the corrupt file is never overwritten

writePolicy.mechanism: write a temp file with flag 'wx' and mode 0600, fsync it, then fs.linkSync(temp, destination)
writePolicy.atomicity: link is atomic create-if-absent; on EEXIST the existing official record wins and is returned
writePolicy.rationale: a later or racing response can never overwrite an already official decision for the same key
writePolicy.evidence: test 08 shows the first durable candidate wins across independent store instances

immutabilityEvidence: no unlink/rename/overwrite path exists in the store; freeze() only ever creates
create-if-absent semantics via linkSync (line 204) with EEXIST handled as 'someone else won'
validateRecord re-derives the identity on every read, so a hand-edited record is rejected as corruption

SAME_FACTS_REUSE_DECISION.scope: identical canonical facts inside a process and across restarts
evidence: test 02: a restart reuses the first durable RAYSOL decision and makes zero second-process LLM calls
test 02a: MISS transitions to HIT through the durable freeze
test 03: twenty simultaneous same-key refreshes produce exactly one LLM call
test 04: changed facts on the same candle create an independent immutable record
test 05: prompt identity and model identity independently invalidate the cache

inFlightDeduplication.mechanism: live/4hBiasV3.js holds a Map keyed by decisionKey (line 176, 234)
inFlightDeduplication.effect: concurrent refreshes for the same key share one promise and one LLM call (test 25)

restartReuse.explanation: after a restart the fact set is rebuilt deterministically; the decision key matches the durable record, so the frozen decision is reused
